basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Developer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in backend-oriented software development and web-based information systems.
Experienced in designing and maintaining enterprise applications, improving code quality, refactoring legacy systems, and contributing across the SDLC in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong background in .NET/C#, Node.js, software architecture, databases, GIS, data processing, and enterprise web applications, with additional experience in DevOps and fintech-related projects.

work.summary: Engineering software and information systems company serving the gas industry.
highlights: Developed and maintained backend systems for gas network simulation, gas consumption forecasting, and transmission network monitoring for the National Iranian Gas Company.
Designed and implemented backend services using C#/.NET with Clean Architecture and CQRS, while contributing to microservices and asynchronous processing using NestJS, RabbitMQ, and TypeORM.
Participated in requirements analysis, system design, code reviews, technical debt management, and continuous refactoring to improve maintainability and extensibility.
Developed GIS infrastructure and geospatial data workflows using OGC standards, WFS, WMS, TMS, OpenLayers, and GeoServer.
Built data processing, web scraping, dynamic reporting, QueryBuilder, and Excel-based reporting solutions.
Contributed to frontend development and DevOps workflows in Agile/Scrum teams, including CI/CD support and mentoring.
Techs: C# | .NET | ASP.NET Core | SQL Server | Clean Architecture | CQRS | Microservices | NestJS | RabbitMQ | Angular | GIS | OGC | GeoServer | Azure DevOps

Designed and developed ParadiseHub, a multi-branch CRM and workspace management platform with 11 user roles, workspace rental, reservations, online payments, wallet payments, financial reporting, and multi-stage application workflows.
Built advanced search and query-building functionality over Elasticsearch for large volumes of unstructured data.
Contributed as a Backend Developer to HR and recruitment platforms, a job-search engine, and mobile applications.
Techs: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | Angular | MongoDB | Elasticsearch
Built a web scraping application collecting job postings from three major Iranian job websites and developed a job search engine with filtering capabilities.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and was invited to join FuTech Group as a software developer.
Techs: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git

work.summary: Freelance embedded systems and software-hardware integration projects.
highlights: Developed embedded control software for an interactive Smart Wall installation.
Enhanced radiation monitoring software to support multiple detectors and configurable alarm control.
Designed and implemented software and hardware prototypes for access control, silo monitoring, and automatic parking-gate control.
Techs: C | C# | AVR | Arduino | Windows Forms | RS-232 | Embedded Systems
